This release is prepared for the requested private use, including copying to
another PC owned by the same user. It is not a public/third-party distribution.
Private use does not require publishing modified application source.
If later conveying this package to other people, the GPL's corresponding-source
obligations must be fulfilled for the exact FFmpeg binary, including enabled
third-party libraries and build scripts. A link to FFmpeg alone is insufficient.
Obtain and provide the complete corresponding source before such distribution.
This package does not claim to include that complete source bundle.
